_comment: APSL companion projects XNU's makefiles expect as siblings of xnu/, pinned to the macOS 11.3 (xnu-7195.141.2) release train. Only repos that actually exist under github.com/apple-oss-distributions are listed here; the historical 'mach'/'libkern' mirrors do not exist upstream (verified 404) and their code is vendored inside xnu/ itself, so they were dropped, as were security_framework/apple_keystore/bsms (no upstream mirror). Revs are immutable commit SHAs resolved from the release-train tags (IOKitUser-100076.120.9 / Libc-1439.141.1); sha256 values are SRI hashes of the GitHub archive tarballs, refreshable with build/scripts/update-src-hashes.sh --write.
